idea: local mission-control dashboard for ~/Projects: scan every git repo, attention queue first, then heatmap/timeline/drill-down
spec_digest: Local mission-control for ~/Projects: Node scanner + Vite/React SPA on :4600; attention queue first, then heatmap/timeline/drill-down.
Must-haves: auto-scan git repos, attention+activity views, per-repo drill-down, live rescan without restart.
Non-goals: no network/GitHub API, no DB, read-only UI, no auth.
Taste: hand-rolled SVG, dense-but-calm, fast; QA hand-computes expected outputs from Domain rules against fixture repos.

decisions.what: Design: TASTE-FORWARD Survey Folio (candidate C) — survey-atlas visual identity (Plates, tokens.css, vermilion-only attention accent), node:http server + SSE rescan progress, contract-freeze-first wave 0; grafted 6 steals: heatmap day-click cross-filter, injectable SSE transport w/ polling fallback (jsdom), shared fixture Snapshot + contract-lock test, rev-list parse-order fixture test, TZ pinned in vitest config, Cmd+K palette
decisions.why: blind judge 43/50 — only candidate covering the full-repo Gazetteer DoD line plus all four nice-to-haves at depth 7 / buildability 8

known_issues.desc: SSE /api/scan-events ends the 200 stream after replay -> EventSource reconnects ~3s forever, replaying stale done events (scanning-state flapping, endless /api/atlas refetches). Reproduced: 4 done events from ONE scan in 12s. Fix queued as R-015. [RESOLVED cycle 11 — conductor probe: 1 done event in 20s persistent window]

last_cycle.outcome: verified via live SSE probe; KI-1 resolved; phase QA
